candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, transport error) at ~2s, causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations erroring while inventory/redis succeed, and checkout p95 latency ~2425ms with 16 502s in 60s.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/logs admitted; latency localized to payment hop by traces only.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with payment ReadTimeout transport errors in traces; inventory/redis succeed. Bounded to downstream payment latency, but payment-side telemetry is absent, so confidence is moderate.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment-side slowness
Payment service logs for timeout root cause
Excluded gateway logs (ev-...-gw-logs) for error detail
